entry.title: Release:Security 51
entry.content: Security 51 is an adventure point-and-click game – and it's now available on GOG, alongside its Soundtrack ! It's an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien – you're not supposed to know. Now on GOG!
entry.dc:creator: GOG News (PL)

entry.title: Release:Maneater
entry.content: Maneater is an action adventure open-world game – and it's now available on GOG! Experience the ultimate power fantasy as the apex predator of the seas - a terrifying SHARK! Maneater is a single player, open world action RPG (ShaRkPG) where YOU are the shark. Starting as a small shark pup you are tasked with surviving the harsh world while eating your way up the ecosystem. You can also get Maneater: Truth Quest and Maneater Apex Edition . Now on GOG!
entry.dc:creator: GOG News (PL)

entry.title: Release:Palm Sugar: A Village Story
entry.content: Palm Sugar: A Village Story is an action adventure metroidvania – and it's now available on GOG! Fight to free your home from a brutal drug cartel while exploring the lively landscape of a fictitious village in South India. Play as Srinu, a sharp-tongued, quick-witted young hero. Wield weapons, outsmart your enemies, and cross paths with a cast of unforgettable characters. Now on GOG!
entry.dc:creator: GOG News (PL)

entry.title: Release:The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
entry.content: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition is an action adventure fantasy game – and it's now available on GOG! A Shadow rises in the North. Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth where war rages beyond the Fellowship’s path. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost. Now on GOG!
entry.dc:creator: GOG News (PL)

entry.title: Coming soon:GRIDbeat!
entry.content: GRIDbeat! is an action adventure puzzle game – and it's coming soon on GOG! Welcome to GRIDbeat! A rhythm-fueled cyber-dungeon crawler where every move must match the music or risk total system shutdown. You just breached Knoss.OS, the planet’s most fortified corporate network, and made off with a payload of priceless data. Now you’re trapped inside, hunted by rogue security protocols and hostile malware. Wishlist it now!

entry.title: Release:Spiral with extras
entry.content: Spiral is an adventure narrative game – and it's now available on GOG! It's a third-person narrative exploration game that shares a poetic vision of cognitive degeneration. Step into the shoes of Bernard as you help him and support him while braving his unravelling mind and reliving his most treasured moments. Somewhere in the distance, the sound of a train whistle can be heard. You can also get the Artbook , Soundtrack , and Curator Edition . Now on GOG!
entry.dc:creator: GOG News (PL)

entry.title: Release:Wars and Warriors: Joan of Arc
entry.content: Wars and Warriors: Joan of Arc is a historical strategy game – and it's now available on GOG! Are You Destined to Free your People from the Hands of Tyranny? The year is 1337. During this, the darkest of ages, the bubonic plague was rampant. Kingdoms rose and fell with every swift blow of the sword. The Old Continent was in a state of great upheaval, as English kings hastily attempted time and again to uphold their claim to the French throne, shaking this fragile kingdom to its very foundation.

entry.title: Release:MOLE
entry.content: MOLE is a psychological horror experience with tactile simulation elements about madness, faith, and the depths we choose to dig – and it’s now available on GOG! Pilot the MOLE, a monstrous post-war drilling machine built to descend deep below the Slavic soil. Fix failing systems, follow voices of the dead, and pray you can survive whatever is sharing your coffin. Will the vessel or your mind break first? Now on GOG!
